title: Ephemeral routing econ pivot - Mar 2031
content:
Sheet: ephemeral-routing-econ-pivot (working)

Columns: Route | Active model | Avg RT ms | P95 ms | Tokens/day | Cost/day $ | Cost/unit (per 1k tokens) | Overshoot risk | Current policy | Owner | Action | Next check

Rows:
- route-search-emb | embed-slim-v2-q8 | 34 | 92 | 1,240,000 | 185.40 | 0.15 | medium | region-priority then fallback-local | Lydia Park | lower batch size -> monitor P95 | 2031-03-16
- route-customer-profile | embed-accuracy-v1 | 48 | 150 | 420,000 | 126.00 | 0.30 | high | geo-pref then backup-small | Carlos Gutierrez | add prefix cache for repeated reads | 2031-03-17
- route-internal-indexing | embed-slim-v2-q8 | 29 | 78 | 2,900,000 | 433.50 | 0.15 | low | dedicated-pool | Maya Chen | test dynamic-quant-mode for heavy tails | 2031-03-18
- route-recommendation-batch | embed-batch-compat | 210 | 880 | 5,000,000 | 1,150.00 | 0.23 | high | batch-first then fallback | Ethan Morales | split route by customer-tier; throttle low-tier | 2031-03-16

Quick pivots / formulas used (scratch):
- Cost/day = Tokens/day / 1000 * Cost/unit
- Cost/unit estimated from infra chargebacks + model GPU-time share (manual estimate column)
- Overshoot risk heuristics: (P95 / SLO) * (Tokens/day trend % last 7d) > threshold -> high

Snapshot metric deltas (last 72h):
- route-search-emb tokens +12%, P95 +18% (esp during 03:00-06:00 UTC)
- route-recommendation-batch tokens +44% (customer campaign), avg RT up 27%
- route-customer-profile tokens steady, but P95 tail increased due to cross-region fallbacks

Observations (raw notes):
- Embedding-slim-v2-q8 performs well on cost but shows tail sensitivity under bursty batches; KV cache hit rate drops when clients send unique keys.
- Recommendation-batch is the cost outlier; campaign -> transient tokens spike, our dedicated pool saturates and falls back to slower model variants causing large P95.
- Cross-region fallback for customer-profile is causing double cost: routed to full-sized model in another region plus added network egress. Need geo-aware fallback that prefers smaller model locally.

Proposed quick actions (prioritized):
1) Immediate (24h): throttle non-paying customer segment on recommendation-batch route; gate by API key metadata (owner: Ethan) [ticket: INC-4127].
2) Short (72h): enable prefix caching for route-customer-profile (owner: Carlos). Quick win expected: 10-20% token reduction on repeated queries.
3) Medium (1 week): experiment dynamic-quant-mode for internal-indexing workload to measure P95 impact (owner: Maya).
4) Medium: evaluate splitting recommendation-batch into customer-tier subroutes and apply different autoscale policies and model quantization (owner: Product + Ethan).

Risks / open questions:
- Do we have budget approval to run temporary burst GPUs in us-west for recommendations? (Billing asked for justification.)
- Is there a CS escalation for customers affected by recommendation latency? (Slack thread: #cs-reco)
- Validation: how will we measure quality regression for quantized variants during the experiment window? Need eval prompts.

Unresolved tickets / refs:
- INC-4127 (recommendation cost spike) — assigned to Ethan; root cause analysis in progress.
- ENG-3124 (geo fallback policy tuning) — linked, needs priority decision.
- PR: serving-runtime#2891 — temporary routing filter merged as experiment, needs rollout notes.

Owner notes / scratchpad:
- Lydia: check KV cache summary table from 2031-03-10 to 2031-03-12
- Carlos: estimate egress cost delta for cross-region fallback
- Maya: run small-scale quant-run overnight, attach outputs to this sheet

Meeting cadence: ad-hoc stand-up Mon/Tue (15m) until stable; otherwise weekly sync.

Last review comments (03/15):
- Product asked to hold on tier-split until legal approves new routing labels (pending).
- SRE recommends soft-throttle vs hard throttle to avoid cascading retries.

"Notes to self": if recommendation-batch remains >$1k/day for three consecutive days, trigger reserve-capacity review and notify finance.

End of sheet (working): keep edits here, then migrate stable decisions to Confluence page when actions are accepted.
